text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P3 deferred cleanup. Current package.scala still aliases Point/IndexedField/SpaceKey and sameIdentityAs, while MapEvidence.scala is already only thin delegation to locus4s certified constructors, not a duplicate proof algorithm. The precise current sameIdentityAs implementation is sameRuntimeOwnerAs; migration must preserve that existing safety unless a call site explicitly needs persistent alignment, never mechanically weaken it to matching IDs. Representation-neutral Field adoption needs actual access-pattern/cost review rather than blanket replacement of intentionally materialized storage. No demonstrated new correctness failure justifies prioritizing this broad rename over core fixes or PHRF. Keep the migration bounded by qualified upstream APIs, explicit source-compatibility notes and native identity tests. Source assessment only; no deletion or consumer migration.
